info.description: Bounded simulator subset of the official Datastream API (v1) discovery document. Every other official method returns HTTP 501 UNIMPLEMENTED. Connection profiles, private connections, routes and streams are configuration metadata: no source or destination is contacted, connectivity is never validated (as with force=true), and no VPC peering, PSC interface or route is created. Passwords, private keys, client secrets, security tokens and raw secret values are refused and never stored; Secret Manager references are kept as given. Streams stay NOT_STARTED: a create or patch that sets any other state is refused, streams.run is unimplemented, and no data, stream object or backfill exists. Connection profile references in streams are not resolved; deleting a private connection with routes requires force=true.
info.title: Datastream (simulator catalog)
